new: Michael Polányi (Polányi Mihály) challenged the positivist view that science is purely impersonal and algorithmic. His best-known idea, that we know more than we can tell, highlights the central role of *hallgatólagos tudás* (tacit knowledge); this is a paraphrase, not a quotation.
why: unquoted paraphrase instead of a "maxim" given in two Hungarian wordings I cannot confirm word for word
